text: Based on the Earth-observation evidence, this 2,843.1-hectare rural property (ASSET-B) shows no significant tree-cover loss after the 2020 baseline. No loss events ≥0.5 hectares occurred between 2021–2025, and only 0.4 hectares of minor fragmentation was detected—below the threshold for regulatory concern. The asset had 23 hectares of tree cover in 2000 but none classified as forest in 2020. While prior losses (e.g., 67.7 hectares in 2020) are noted, they fall outside the claim period. Compliance cannot be directly asserted, but the data supports no *post-2020* deforestation, aligning with EUDR-like thresholds. Small changes (<0.5 ha) may be undetected due to pixel limitations.
